title: Platform management
description: Real records, moderation and service settings.

dashboard.intro: Your properties, guests and bookings, all in one place.
dashboard.invalidRange: Select a valid range of up to 366 days, ending no later than today.
dashboard.chartEmpty: No data for this period yet
dashboard.chartEmptyDescription: Your first operations will appear here.
dashboard.recentDescription: The latest guest requests and statuses
dashboard.emptyDescription: New requests will appear here. Try a different period or filters.
dashboard.quickDescription: Go straight to tasks that need your attention
dashboard.providerConfiguredDescription: Payment statuses arrive through a server webhook. Configuring a provider does not confirm a transaction; revenue comes from confirmed KGS records.
dashboard.providerDescription: Payments are available for viewing. Revenue includes PAID records in KGS with a payment date and transaction ID. Demo properties and bookings are excluded.
dashboard.source: Property and account statistics are current totals. Bookings and payments use the selected period. Active bookings: CONFIRMED with an upcoming checkout.
dashboard.errorDescription: Check the database connection and try again.
dashboard.providerUnavailableDescription: Payments are available for viewing. Configure the provider and server webhook to accept payments. Demo operations are excluded from revenue.

manage.manageDescription: Manage your platform. Changes are saved to the database.
manage.confirmBody: This change will be saved. Continue?
manage.deleteHint: Cabins with booking history must be archived.
manage.calendarHint: End date is exclusive. Booked dates cannot be changed.
manage.calendarTooMany: Use search to select a cabin.
manage.codeHint: Leave code empty for an automatic offer. Offer dates must cover the whole stay. The single largest discount applies.
manage.securityHint: Administrator sign-in requires a password and Telegram code. Changing the password revokes sessions.
manage.roleHint: Only SUPER_ADMIN can manage administrator roles. The last active administrator is protected.
manage.messagesHint: Send users messages through site notifications. An incoming support ticket system is not connected.
manage.revenueNote: Actual KGS receipts. The current Finik integration charges a fixed 5 KGS, rather than the full booking amount.
manage.notificationsDescription: New platform events and user messages.
manage.noOwners: First add and verify an owner in the Owners section.
